title: Evaluate a Special Function
prompt: Use gamma and error-function values to verify a small numerical calculation.
objective: Demonstrate scipy.special through a focused scientific-computing task, then verify the result.

starter.code:
from scipy.special import gamma, erf

# Evaluate gamma(5) and erf(1.0).
# Add assertions using suitable tolerances.
starter.instructions: Complete locally in an isolated Python environment with SciPy installed. The platform does not execute arbitrary Python in the production API.

expected_output: A correct implementation should demonstrate scipy.special, satisfy all acceptance criteria, and report at least one independent validation or limitation.
acceptance_criteria: Use the relevant API or concept: scipy.special.
Use a small deterministic synthetic input and document its units/shape/domain where relevant.
Validate the computed output with an appropriate assertion, residual, tolerance, or diagnostic.
Explain one limitation or assumption of the selected method.
hints: Translate the prompt into input, operation, expected behavior, and an independent check.
Look up the documented signature for scipy.special; inspect status and error information where available.
Test one boundary or invalid input before considering the work complete.
grading_method: Server-side configured static/concept grading plus rubric review. Static string checks do not execute Python and do not prove numerical correctness; run the solution in an isolated local environment.
retry_policy: Allow retries. Incorrect or incomplete attempts do not complete the activity; repeated correct submissions must not produce additional activity rewards.
status_note: Draft exercise based on the supplied PDF. Local numerical test execution, answer-key review, and grading-contract review remain required.
